purpose: Public release handover inventory. This is documentation, not an install catalogue or a trust file.

verification.method: Older application and pack entries preserve the initial 2026-10-04 GitHub metadata audit and dated publication evidence. For the October optional packs, public release assets were independently downloaded and rehashed, source/scientific regressions retained, and exact-final archives executed through the released 0.6.0 native Windows bridge in ordinary and space-containing paths. Per-asset download verification and per-pack evidence distinguish these levels. Kraken2 and Bracken final asset verification and exact-final native gates are retained separately, including a real classification-to-estimation chain.
verification.scope: Published releases only. Drafts and private metadata are excluded. Historical validation candidates are excluded from current_packs.
verification.interpretation: A GitHub asset digest checks bytes against recorded metadata; it is not a publisher signature or application-trusted catalogue.
verification.application_method: All nine public 0.8.0 assets were anonymously downloaded after publication and matched their current GitHub sizes/SHA-256 values; four ZIP CRCs and both checksum manifests passed. Six original companions are byte-identical to accepted candidate b3928ca. Existing candidate native execution evidence applies to those exact bytes; a read-only post-publication verification workflow is pending. Pack entries retain their independent historical inventory and validation dates.

application.source_commit_distinction: Published starter, source and 0.6.0 updater are the exact accepted b3928ca candidate bytes. The later release-tag commit contains publication/evidence/documentation changes; no accepted application, gate, build or pack code was rebuilt or changed.

tester_acceptance.statement: Testers are happy with the accepted candidate; publication authorized.

validation.scope: Accepted native three-pane Tools/Workflow UI, independent in-process edits, installed-pack input choices, explicit reusable inputs and compatible linking, canvas pan/zoom/deletion/Undo, corrected initial Manage tools and scrolling behavior. Exact candidate References gate exercises five-product GUI downloads/cancellation, pinned identities, offline reuse/provenance, native SAMtools indexing and preservation during upgrade.

core_update.scope: Exact 0.6.0 base manifest required; no 0.7.0-to-0.8.0 updater or migration result is supplied.

long_path_regression.scope: Starter tools and recorded deeply nested result paths, not arbitrary optional-tool, installation-root or native-folder-picker paths; application makes no user-machine policy change.

scroll_regression.scope: Finite 96-DPI hosted desktop sampling masks edit/button animation; tester acceptance is separately reported and no universal display or hardware guarantee is inferred.

publication_workflow.completed_before_failure: Verified all nine uploaded draft assets, then published the development prerelease.
publication_workflow.failure: The first anonymous public asset GET returned HTTP 404 after publication; the incomplete verification state was preserved.
publication_workflow.subsequent_resolution: Independent anonymous downloads of all nine public assets later passed, as recorded in the separate public-download report. No published assets were replaced.

limits: Hosted native display tests used Windows Server 2022, 96 DPI. Physical tester acceptance is user-reported; no tester hardware details were supplied.
Old and new packages both had zero unexpected frames in finite CI sampling; CI did not reproduce the reported visual flashing. Precision-wheel failure was reproduced and corrected.
Finite frame samples mask edit/button animation and cannot exclude between-sample flashes; no general high-DPI, multi-monitor or physical-trackpad claim.
Migration was verified from 0.6.0 only. No 0.7.0-to-0.8.0 updater is included or claimed.
Long-path validation covers recorded starter outputs, not every optional tool or native folder picker.
validation.immutable_creation_time_status: BUILD-PROVENANCE.json and matching source retain their creation-time candidate statements; separate release validation/public-download records supply later evidence without replacing original companions.

post_publication_verification_gate.scope: Read-only recovery of the exact promotion artifact and fresh anonymous downloads of all nine canonical public URLs. Candidate native evidence is reused for unchanged application bytes; no new native execution is claimed.
